header.running_head: The Hospitality and service that the Ansaar Rendered

blocks.text: performing salaah. He bade me to continue my salaah and when I had finished, he asked, 'What is it that you said?' After informing him, he said, 'I had given that set of clothing to a Sahabi who had participated in the Battle of Badr, the Battle of Uhud and the Pledge of Aqaba. The youngster from the Quraysh (who you saw) went to him, bought it from him and then wore it. Did you think that it (giving preference to others over the Ansaar) would occur during my time?' I conceded by saying, 'I swear by Allaah that I do not think that it would occur during your rein as Khalifah.'" [^1]
The Story of Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA)

Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) narrates that as he was going to the Masjid, he noticed a man from the Quraysh wearing a set of (good) clothing. When he asked the man who gave him the clothing, the man replied, "The Ameerul Mu'mineen." After he had passed by Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) noticed another man from the Quraysh wearing a set of (good) clothing. When he asked the man who gave him the clothing, the man also replied that the Ameerul Mu'mineen had given it to him. When Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) entered the Masjid, he exclaimed in a loud voice, "Allaahu Akbar! Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ have spoken the truth! Allaahu Akbar! Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ have spoken the truth!"
When Hadhrat Umar (RA) heard this, he sent someone to call him. Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) told the man that he first had to perform two Rakaahs of salaah. Hadhrat Umar (RA) sent the messenger again with the message that he insists that Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) should go to him. However, Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) was adamant that he would not go to Hadhrat Umar (RA) until he had performed two Rakaahs of salaah. He therefore started his salaah. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then came himself and sat beside Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA). When he had complete his salaah, Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Do tell me why you raised your voice calling the Takbeer in the place where Rasulullaah ﷺ performed salaah. And why did you say, 'Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ have spoken the truth'."
Hadhrat Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) replied, " O Ameerul Mu'mineen! I was proceeding to the Masjid when I noticed a certain man from the Quraysh wearing a set of (good) clothing. When I asked him who gave him the clothing, the man replied that the Ameerul Mu'mineen had given it to him. After he had passed by I noticed another man from the Quraysh wearing a set of (good) clothing. When I asked the man who gave him the clothing, the man also replied that the Ameerul Mu'mineen had given it to him. After he had passed by I noticed a man from the Ansaar wearing a set of clothing that was less expensive than the two others.
